description: Lines and cells that run or can run the theme CLI through a data-only look-alike. Every entry is blocked at every door it applies to (a line: classifyThemeLine block plus eval-wrapped block; a cell: planEvalThemeCode block). Block codes are recorded from the code under test.

entries.note: --pre runs the program named by its value
--pre with a theme command as its words
--pre=value
-f is not on the allow-list
$(...) as an argument
backtick in a double-quoted pattern runs
a real command after a data segment
pipe target is the CLI

entries.text: gh alias set t 'hrv theme publish 1'
entries.note: gh alias is not an allowed subcommand

entries.text: gh api repos/o/r/issues -f title="hrv theme publish 1"
entries.note: gh api is not an allowed subcommand

entries.text: gh issue create --title x && hrv theme publish 1
entries.note: gh data segment followed by a real command
$(...) as an argument
variable that holds the CLI

entries.text: rg x > .haravan-cli_local.json && hrv theme push --only a.liquid
entries.note: redirect into the binding file, then a push
a comment opens a quote the shell never sees

entries.text: echo $'a\'; rg "x ' ; hrv theme publish 1 ; echo '" f
entries.note: ANSI-C string closes where the splitter thinks a quote continues
